dictionaries.name: Raj&Co-MedSpelChek
dictionaries.summary: Raj&Co-MedSpelChek (Rajasekharan N.): free medical transcription word list for MS Word with drug, anatomical, surgical and laboratory terms.

dictionaries.name: MeSH 2026
dictionaries.summary: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) from the U.S. National Library of Medicine: controlled vocabulary names for diseases, anatomy, drugs, techniques and other biomedical concepts.

dictionaries.name: RxNorm
dictionaries.summary: RxNorm (U.S. National Library of Medicine) prescribable release: generic and brand names of prescribable drug products.

dictionaries.name: ICD-11 MMS
dictionaries.summary: ICD-11 MMS titles (World Health Organization): names of diseases, injuries, symptoms and other health conditions from the International Classification of Diseases 11th Revision.

dictionaries.name: LOINC
dictionaries.summary: LOINC (Regenstrief Institute): names of laboratory tests and clinical observations (long common names, components and short names).

dictionaries.name: Human Phenotype Ontology
dictionaries.summary: Human Phenotype Ontology: terms and synonyms for phenotypic abnormalities (signs and symptoms) used in clinical genetics.

dictionaries.name: CIEL
dictionaries.summary: CIEL (Columbia International eHealth Laboratory): English concept names from the OpenMRS concept dictionary covering diagnoses, findings, drugs, tests and procedures.
